goal.toCalculateYourDayChef: To calculate your day, Chef Mealan asks a few things about your body: female or male, your birth year, height, weight, and your body fat if you know it. Later, also the weigh-ins you add. Chef Mealan keeps only these and the numbers they give, on this phone and in your account, for as long as you have the account. You can export or delete them any time. Nothing is kept until you agree. More in the

formula.threePublishedFormulasOrYour: Three published formulas, or your own 14 days. Pick one, and all your numbers follow.
formula.threePublishedFormulasPickOne: Three published formulas. Pick one, and all your numbers follow.
formula.fromSexAgeHeightAnd: From sex, age, height and weight. Made from about 500 adults aged 19 to 78. In reviews it lands closest to the measured burn for most adults, so it is the default.
formula.fromLeanMassYourWeight: From lean mass: your weight without the body fat. Sex and age don't enter. Good for lean, muscular people, when the body fat is measured well.
formula.theFormulaFaoWhoAnd: The formula FAO, WHO and UNU use. From sex and weight, in three adult age bands: 18 to 30, 30 to 60, over 60. Made from about 7,000 measurements in many countries. Height doesn't enter. It often gives a little more than Mifflin St Jeor.
formula.onlyTheRestingBurnYour: Only the resting burn. Your everyday, your training, your goal and your protein stay the same.
formula.katchMcardleOnceYouAdd: Katch McArdle once you add your body fat.
formula.addYourBodyFatUnder: Add your body fat under You.
formula.leanMassFromYourBody: Lean mass, from your body fat.
formula.schofieldAndMifflinStJeor: Schofield and Mifflin St Jeor give the same resting burn for you.
formula.needsFullDaysAndWeigh: Needs 10 full days and 7 weigh-ins in 14 days.
protein.whyARangeNotOne: Why a range, not one number
protein.studiesOnPeopleWhoTrain: Studies on people who train show that muscle keeps growing with more protein up to about 1.6 g per kg a day, and that almost nobody gains more above 2.2 g. Anywhere in that range works. The bottom is the minimum to aim for every day; going above the top doesn't build more muscle.
protein.whatMovesYouToThe: What moves you to the top
protein.threeThingsLosingFatBecause: Three things: losing fat, because more protein helps you keep your muscle while you eat less; eating mostly plant protein, because the body uses it a little less well; and being over 60, because muscles respond less to protein with age.
protein.itSADailyTotal: It's a daily total, spread over the day
protein.meatFishEggsAndDairy: Meat, fish, eggs and dairy give the body everything it needs to build muscle. Plant foods do too, if you combine them, for example beans with grains. Chef Mealan counts every gram the same, and moves the target up for plant eaters instead.
protein.sourcesMortonEtAlProtein: Sources: Morton et al. 2018 (protein and muscle growth); ISSN position stand 2017 (protein and exercise); Helms et al. 2014 (protein when losing fat); PROT-AGE 2013 (protein in older adults).

safetyq.chefMealanIsAnAi.text: Chef Mealan is an AI chef. It reads labels and suggests plates, and it can be wrong: check a number against the pack, and check anything about your health with a professional. If one of these is true for you, Chef Mealan steps back from that topic, tells you who to talk to, and still helps with the plate. Your coach sees that you ticked one and when, never what you wrote.
